speaker: Logos
content: ...I remember you.

raw: [name="Logos"]The traitors you mentioned were a family of three who wanted to flee Kazdel in search of a peaceful life.
speaker: Logos
content: The traitors you mentioned were a family of three who wanted to flee Kazdel in search of a peaceful life.

raw: [name="'Sudaram'?"]They swore an oath of fealty to the Royal Court.
speaker: 'Sudaram'?
content: They swore an oath of fealty to the Royal Court.

raw: [name="Logos"]The Royal Court should never be held above ordinary Sarkaz. You may have been a war hero of Kazdel once, but I cannot allow you to slaughter civilians.
speaker: Logos
content: The Royal Court should never be held above ordinary Sarkaz. You may have been a war hero of Kazdel once, but I cannot allow you to slaughter civilians.

raw: [name="'Sudaram'?"]So, you chose Babel, and Theresa... all for the sake of your so-called 'ordinary Sarkaz'.
speaker: 'Sudaram'?
content: So, you chose Babel, and Theresa... all for the sake of your so-called 'ordinary Sarkaz'.

raw: [name="Logos"]That is the righteous path to the future.
speaker: Logos
content: That is the righteous path to the future.

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]But even after she died, you still didn't return to Kazdel!
speaker: Babel Member?
content: But even after she died, you still didn't return to Kazdel!

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]You even helped those outsiders steal away the King of Sarkaz!
speaker: Babel Member?
content: You even helped those outsiders steal away the King of Sarkaz!

raw: [name="Logos"]The inheritance of the King of Sarkaz was a decision made by Her Highness Theresa.
speaker: Logos
content: The inheritance of the King of Sarkaz was a decision made by Her Highness Theresa.

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]You killed me with your own hands.
speaker: Babel Member?
content: You killed me with your own hands.

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]When your incantations were coiling around my heart, strangling it... Haha, I couldn't believe it.
speaker: Babel Member?
content: When your incantations were coiling around my heart, strangling it... Haha, I couldn't believe it.

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]After fighting alongside each other for so many years, whatever you felt towards me paled in comparison to those outsiders.
speaker: Babel Member?
content: After fighting alongside each other for so many years, whatever you felt towards me paled in comparison to those outsiders.

raw: [name="Logos"]The potted goldengrass you left behind on the ship is growing well now.
speaker: Logos
content: The potted goldengrass you left behind on the ship is growing well now.

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]After Her Highness's death, how many comrades did you slay with your own hands during the internal strife that engulfed Babel?
speaker: Babel Member?
content: After Her Highness's death, how many comrades did you slay with your own hands during the internal strife that engulfed Babel?

raw: [name="Babel Member?"]The belongings left behind by so many people... I'm sure there's enough of 'em to fill your whole room, huh? Do you feel sorrow every time you look at that patch of grass I planted in that pot on a whim?
speaker: Babel Member?
content: The belongings left behind by so many people... I'm sure there's enough of 'em to fill your whole room, huh? Do you feel sorrow every time you look at that patch of grass I planted in that pot on a whim?

speaker: Logos
content: If I were to feel sorrow...

raw: [name="Logos"]It would be because even death has denied you the solace you deserve.
speaker: Logos
content: It would be because even death has denied you the solace you deserve.

raw: [name="Logos"]Damazti, you were never so keen to dress yourself up as the 'dead' before.
speaker: Logos
content: Damazti, you were never so keen to dress yourself up as the 'dead' before.

raw: [name="Logos"]This exchange of words cannot provide you with any answers, nor can probing my emotions.
speaker: Logos
content: This exchange of words cannot provide you with any answers, nor can probing my emotions.
The dead do not respond.

raw: They continue to emerge from the dark crystal clusters.
content: They continue to emerge from the dark crystal clusters.

raw: Many faces, some familiar, others not. All of them Sarkaz.
content: Many faces, some familiar, others not. All of them Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Logos"]Your innate abilities are resonating with the information stored inside the Originium.
speaker: Logos
content: Your innate abilities are resonating with the information stored inside the Originium.

raw: [name="Logos"]Seeing as how your powers have grown thanks to the Originium–
speaker: Logos
content: Seeing as how your powers have grown thanks to the Originium–
Logos raises one hand.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
No incantations are needed – just a low humming sound from the vibrating of the rock walls.
content: No incantations are needed – just a low humming sound from the vibrating of the rock walls.

raw: In a heartbeat, all of the Damazti's clones are shattered.
content: In a heartbeat, all of the Damazti's clones are shattered.

speaker: Logos
content: Just as expected.

raw: [name="Logos"]There's one left... the very last one.
speaker: Logos
content: There's one left... the very last one.

speaker: Logos
content: It's you.

raw: The Vampire stands there in the cave's depths, his expression almost identical to when he stood atop the Feranmut's skull that day.
content: The Vampire stands there in the cave's depths, his expression almost identical to when he stood atop the Feranmut's skull that day.

raw: However, it is no longer fresh blood that roils around him as before, but rather clusters of Originium crystal.
content: However, it is no longer fresh blood that roils around him as before, but rather clusters of Originium crystal.

raw: Logos can feel the blood in his body stirring.
content: Logos can feel the blood in his body stirring.

speaker: Logos
content: The Sanguinarch of Vampires... Duq'arael.

raw: [name="Logos"]You're not like the others. I know this.
speaker: Logos
content: You're not like the others. I know this.

raw: [name="Logos"]You are not one of the Damazti's avatars.
speaker: Logos
content: You are not one of the Damazti's avatars.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Lord Damazti, this portion of you decided to assist Qui'sartuštaj.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Lord Damazti, this portion of you decided to assist Qui'sartuštaj.

raw: [name="Damazti Cluster"]No... We have no interest in helping anyone in particular. We are simply... searching for answers.
speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: No... We have no interest in helping anyone in particular. We are simply... searching for answers.

raw: [name="Damazti Cluster"]Kal'tsit, we have met you before. When the Sarkaz were not yet Sarkaz.
speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: Kal'tsit, we have met you before. When the Sarkaz were not yet Sarkaz.

speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: You walked across us.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I have no recollection of any such meeting.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I have no recollection of any such meeting.

raw: [name="Damazti Cluster"]At that time, we were unable to speak.
speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: At that time, we were unable to speak.

speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: And then...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The first King of Teekaz came in contact with Originium.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The first King of Teekaz came in contact with Originium.

speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: That was our first 'awakening'.

raw: [name="Damazti Cluster"]The first individual rose up from among us.
speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: The first individual rose up from among us.

speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: We felt one another.

raw: [name="Damazti Cluster"]We had existed for an unknown amount of time before that. But, it was only at that moment when we became aware of our existence.
speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: We had existed for an unknown amount of time before that. But, it was only at that moment when we became aware of our existence.

speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: Because we began to 'think'.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Originium will assimilate all lifeforms it comes into contact with.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Originium will assimilate all lifeforms it comes into contact with.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Not just you. But also the original Vampires, Banshees, and Wendigos... All Teekaz have changed. You are approaching the form of another entity that once existed on this land.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Not just you. But also the original Vampires, Banshees, and Wendigos... All Teekaz have changed. You are approaching the form of another entity that once existed on this land.

speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: Then, what are you?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Howls agitatedly)

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]It seems extremely averse to seeing another self.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: It seems extremely averse to seeing another self.

speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Kal'tsit... the Immortal.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]Do you still remember what you looked like at first?
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Do you still remember what you looked like at first?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The 'Immortal' is a figment of certain people's imaginations, and a misrepresentation of my self.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The 'Immortal' is a figment of certain people's imaginations, and a misrepresentation of my self.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Time leaves its marks upon me all the same. The original entity by the name of 'Kal'tsit' has long been lost beneath the golden sands.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Time leaves its marks upon me all the same. The original entity by the name of 'Kal'tsit' has long been lost beneath the golden sands.

speaker: Mon3tr?
content: But, you are still yourself.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]We were watching as you were reborn at Theresa's side.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: We were watching as you were reborn at Theresa's side.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]You are different from your previous self, from your appearance to your personality.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: You are different from your previous self, from your appearance to your personality.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]We are used to constant change for the sake of survival.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: We are used to constant change for the sake of survival.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]Among the Sarkaz, the Damazti Cluster is unique. We once thought that you were like us.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Among the Sarkaz, the Damazti Cluster is unique. We once thought that you were like us.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]We know many 'Kal'tsit', just as Kal'tsit knows many of us.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: We know many 'Kal'tsit', just as Kal'tsit knows many of us.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]However, we will always be a whole. Each Damazti is a receptor for us to feel this land.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: However, we will always be a whole. Each Damazti is a receptor for us to feel this land.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]But, 'Kal'tsit' is different. Each Kal'tsit is still you.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: But, 'Kal'tsit' is different. Each Kal'tsit is still you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I do believe that to be true.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I do believe that to be true.

speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Why?

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]Is it the inheritance of memory that makes you so persistent? Memory can be easily tampered with and implanted. This, we know, for many long-lived beings have tried such methods.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Is it the inheritance of memory that makes you so persistent? Memory can be easily tampered with and implanted. This, we know, for many long-lived beings have tried such methods.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Such 'immortality' is nothing but an empty lie.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Such 'immortality' is nothing but an empty lie.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]Then, is it some kind of duty...
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Then, is it some kind of duty...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I won't deny that my life has been duty-bound from the moment I was born.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I won't deny that my life has been duty-bound from the moment I was born.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Looking back, I don't think... I've ever truly been 'alive'.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Looking back, I don't think... I've ever truly been 'alive'.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]The substances that make up your body have all been replaced. The memories inherited from your previous self are unreliable. The mission imposed upon you may not even be your own.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: The substances that make up your body have all been replaced. The memories inherited from your previous self are unreliable. The mission imposed upon you may not even be your own.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]Kal'tsit, what is it that has kept the continuity of you across these thousands of years?
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: Kal'tsit, what is it that has kept the continuity of you across these thousands of years?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: A name.

raw: [name="Mon3tr?"]A unique name, or a title? It is a question that so many emotionally deprived Sarkaz would be keenly interested in.
speaker: Mon3tr?
content: A unique name, or a title? It is a question that so many emotionally deprived Sarkaz would be keenly interested in.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: This name, has many meanings.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The person who gave me this name, and the people I care about, are now in danger. This isn't the time for us to be having this chat.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The person who gave me this name, and the people I care about, are now in danger. This isn't the time for us to be having this chat.

raw: [name="Damazti Cluster"]We did not expect you to be this sentimental.
speaker: Damazti Cluster
content: We did not expect you to be this sentimental.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Mon3tr.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Excited howl)
